# The Purpose of Life

What is the purpose of life? People have been asking that for, well, forever. Philosophers wrote enormous books about it. The stars kept mysteriously quiet, and the cat said, nap.

So we went looking up mountains, under the sea, deep into the fine print, and along the way, without really noticing, we picked up little bits and pieces. A laugh with a friend, soup on a cold day, a dog who's thrilled you're home, a kindness for a stranger.

Turns out, life doesn't come with a purpose. It comes with scissors and glue. So cut out the good bits, stick them together, and make it mean something.
